rationale.consistency: trimPathSuffix mirrors trimPathPrefix's structure, doc comment style, EqualFold use, and error-return-unchanged idiom exactly.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles empty path/suffix, escape detection from the end (correct since '%' only starts escapes in EscapedPath), escaped-suffix literal matching, case-insensitive hex, non-matching suffix untouched.
rationale.scope: Only replaces the broken reverse-based call and adds the helper; removing reverse is justified since it becomes dead code.
rationale.readability: Clear lock-step backward iteration with explanatory comments; the double-negated `!(iSuffix >= 2 && ...)` condition is slightly dense.
rationale.robustness: All index accesses are bounds-guarded, no panics on short inputs, decode failure returns path unchanged, no shared state.
rationale.maintainability: Parallels prefix logic so future fixes are easy to mirror, though the two functions are near-duplicates that could drift apart.
